response.sql: WITH member_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), with_totals AS (SELECT link_to_major, member_count, SUM(member_count) OVER () as total_members, CAST(member_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(member_count) OVER () as share FROM member_counts), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_totals), above_average_groups AS (SELECT wt.link_to_major, wt.member_count, wt.share, asc.avg_share FROM with_totals wt CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc WHERE wt.share > asc.avg_share) SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_distance_above_average FROM above_average_groups
